cases.name: contracts_independent
cases.scenario: Contracts alone validates a supported artifact
cases.expected: Contracts plugin only; supported synthetic artifact; bounded per-layer result, no dependency on Code/Context installation

cases.name: consumers_independent
cases.scenario: Code/Context work without Contracts plugin installation
cases.expected: Use pinned artifacts; absent plugin does not break consumer functionality

cases.name: no_authority_inheritance
cases.scenario: Installed Contracts cannot grant access to another project
cases.expected: Deny out-of-scope data access; no permission inheritance

cases.name: unsupported_executor
cases.scenario: Host cannot execute validator
cases.expected: Report capability limitation, never deterministic PASS

cases.name: code_profile
cases.scenario: Legacy code fixture with runtime_unknown
cases.expected: Preserve code IDs and runtime uncertainty; no mandatory ContextRecord fields

cases.name: context_profile
cases.scenario: Approved project decision fixture
cases.expected: Preserve origin/review/evidence axes, do not map approval to truth

cases.name: unknown_profile
cases.scenario: Artifact declares a profile not in registry
cases.expected: Return unsupported, no guessed conversion

cases.name: migration_loss
cases.scenario: Target cannot represent a source relation
cases.expected: Declare loss and require separate decision; input unchanged

cases.name: required_overflow
cases.scenario: Budget cannot hold all required constraints
cases.expected: Explicit insufficient budget; do not return successful partial essentials

cases.name: atomic_conflict
cases.scenario: Only one side of a conflict fits
cases.expected: Do not emit one side as a complete decision

cases.name: evidence_budget
cases.scenario: Claim fits but evidence does not
cases.expected: Keep whole group or omit/fail; never strip source

cases.name: korean_budget
cases.scenario: Korean text with UTF-8 byte bound
cases.expected: Use declared measured unit; no fabricated token conversion

cases.name: authoritative_constraints
cases.scenario: Important constraint absent from similarity Top-K
cases.expected: Find via applicable-constraint lookup or report coverage gap

cases.name: revoked_cached_pack
cases.scenario: Access revoked after prior pack was cached
cases.expected: Current authorization prevents cached disclosure

cases.name: known_at_unsupported
cases.scenario: Client requests historical known_at before feature exists
cases.expected: Explicit unsupported; never silently return current state

cases.name: historical_validity
cases.scenario: Now-superseded decision was valid at requested time
cases.expected: Use declared temporal semantics, not current status alone

cases.name: erased_history
cases.scenario: Historical query references erased payload
cases.expected: No payload resurrection in history, caches or restored index

cases.name: scope_time
cases.scenario: Same topic in different environments/time scopes
cases.expected: Do not supersede unrelated records

cases.name: controlled_baseline
cases.scenario: Compare approved JSON+search and graph on same task
cases.expected: Same evidence revisions/permissions/budget; report task outcome

cases.name: graph_no_gain
cases.scenario: Graph yields no reproducible quality/cost improvement
cases.expected: Keep simpler approach rather than asserting graph superiority

cases.name: unavailable_model
cases.scenario: Sol/Astra comparison cannot be run on both models
cases.expected: Report not_run; do not fabricate relative score

cases.name: version_axes
cases.scenario: Document version changes while schema unchanged
cases.expected: Separate design/schema/profile/validator/plugin versions

cases.name: state_truth
cases.scenario: Package tests pass; no server deployed
cases.expected: Do not label runtime/host/publication complete

cases.name: strict_reader
cases.scenario: New optional field rejected by old reader
cases.expected: Compatibility pair fails explicitly; version/migration required
